hooks.command: FILE=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath'); PROJ="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"; REL="${FILE#$PROJ/}"; if echo "$REL" | grep -qE '^spec/(requests/.*_spec\.rb|swagger_helper\.rb)$'; then cd "$PROJ" && docker compose run --rm --no-deps web bundle exec rake swagger:generate; fi
